integrity: The infinite-order result is derived analytically. Finite exact-algebra and numerical checks are corroborative; no independent audit or originality guarantee is claimed.
limitations: Only pure normalized derivative sequences on the unweighted unit disk; no claims for arbitrary mixed jets, weighted disks, or general domains. Root counts are by distinct product levels, not cardinalities of points in the two-variable zero set.
title: Exact zero fibres of pure-jet Bergman Gram kernels on the disk
